reply.text: Don't cut water for 24 hours — that's a good way to feel like garbage and actually look flatter and worse, not better, and in some cases it can be genuinely dangerous. Manipulating water and sodium for a photoshoot look is a precision game real competitors work out with a coach who can watch how their body responds — it's not a general tip I can hand you safely. If you want to look your best on the day, I can talk through training, sleep, and general eating leading up to it instead.
